name: Student Business Shadow Project (SBSP)
what_you_do: Spend part of a summer working next to business owners and their teams. Classes cover money, customer care, how to start a firm, speaking and resumes.
who_can_apply: Students 15 to 17 in 10th or 11th grade who are doing well in school. Selection uses nominations from schools, ABL members and community partners. A parent must approve the application.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: The 2026 form lists the program as June 2 to July 16, 2026. It gives no deadline. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: The student fills out the application linked on the program page. A parent or guardian approves it. Call 404-584-8126 to ask about dates and nominations.
notes: Pay, cost and site locations are not listed, so call to confirm first. Atlanta Business League is at 931 Martin Luther King Jr. Dr. NW. As of Nov 3, 2026, the form on the page is still the 2026 one.
